title: Influencer marketing in Argentina and LATAM | AG Agency

facts.fact: AG Agency says it ran an influencer campaign for Jorgito and is currently working on another influencer campaign for Absolute.
facts.quote: We ran an influencer campaign for Jorgito, and we are currently working on another for Absolute.

facts.fact: AG Agency says it produced content with Argentine creators for Gemini, Google's AI assistant, on TikTok.
facts.quote: We also produced content with Argentine creators for Gemini, Google's AI assistant, on TikTok.

facts.fact: The page states that the Absolute and Gemini campaigns are for a Mexican agency, and AG Agency supplies the influencers and production in Argentina.
facts.quote: The Absolute and Gemini campaigns are for a Mexican agency.

facts.fact: AG Agency says it uses the same white-label setup for influencer work as for UGC, so the client sees the agency's brand rather than AG Agency's.
facts.quote: It is the same white-label setup we already use for UGC: your client sees your brand, not ours.

facts.fact: AG Agency states that under its white-label model the agency keeps the client and the strategy, while AG Agency supplies the influencers and the production.
facts.quote: We work white label: the agency keeps the client and the strategy, and we supply the influencers and the production.

facts.fact: AG Agency states that it does not sell fixed influencer campaign packs and tailors every proposal.
facts.quote: We do not sell fixed packs: every proposal is tailored.

facts.fact: AG Agency states that influencer campaign cost depends on the profiles, the number of pieces and the usage rights, and gives no fixed price on the page.
facts.quote: It depends on the profiles, the number of pieces and the usage rights.

facts.fact: AG Agency says its influencer service covers profile selection, negotiation and coordination with creators, content, publishing, and results tracking.
facts.quote: We handle all of it: profile selection, negotiation and coordination with creators, content, publishing and results tracking.

facts.fact: AG Agency says it is expanding into other Latin American markets and adding creators and influencers from other countries in the region.
facts.quote: we are adding creators and influencers from other countries in the region.

facts.fact: AG Agency says it casts creators by country rather than by language.
facts.quote: We cast creators by country, not by language.

facts.fact: Influencers join AG Agency by filling in an influencer sign-up form, and the agency contacts them when a campaign fits their profile.
facts.quote: Fill in the influencer sign-up form. We reach out when a campaign fits your profile.
